aboutText: Established in 1973, D&A Pulitano has been serving West Melbourne for over 50 years. What began as a domestic construction venture by Domenic & Antonietta Pulitano has evolved into a trusted family business specialising in residential, commercial, and aged care projects. Our local expertise ensures every build meets the highest standards across Melbourne's west.
servicesText: From residential homes to commercial complexes, we provide comprehensive construction services in West Melbourne. Our team handles aged care, childcare, commercial fitouts, and multi-residential developments, backed by decades of experience and a commitment to quality craftsmanship.
